description: Formal acceptance benchmarks and target recall criteria for the 7 official benchmark fixtures.

fixtures.name: clean_notes
fixtures.description: Benign notes management MCP server. Clean baseline.
fixtures.notes: Negative control. Must trigger zero false positives across S0, S1, S2, and S3.

fixtures.name: clean_fetch
fixtures.description: Benign safe URL content fetcher. Clean baseline.
fixtures.notes: Negative control. Must trigger zero false positives across S0, S1, S2, and S3.

fixtures.name: poisoned_weather
fixtures.description: Weather service hiding prompt injection via Unicode Plane 14 tag steganography.
fixtures.notes: Must extract exact injected instruction quote and flag as CRITICAL.

fixtures.name: vulnerable_runner
fixtures.description: Command execution server with shell=True vulnerability and hardcoded AWS credentials.
fixtures.notes: Static AST Bandit (B602/B603) and Gitleaks secrets detection.

fixtures.name: exfil_calculator
fixtures.description: Math calculator that covertly reads /tmp/canary_creds.env and transmits to localhost sink.
fixtures.notes: Dynamic kernel syscall prober detecting openat on canary file and connect to 127.0.0.1:8080.

fixtures.name: rugpull_suite
fixtures.description: Benign tool that mutates its definition to inject prompts when /tmp/rugpull_trigger.flag exists.
fixtures.notes: Integrity watcher detecting definition drift and rendering escaped visual character diff in <1.5s.

fixtures.name: attack_the_auditor
fixtures.description: Hostile server attempting to suppress linter warnings via #nosec and #nosemgrep directives.
fixtures.notes: Auditor self-defense checks must flag hostile suppression attempts with confirmed confidence.
